definition: GPT-5 is a multimodal large language model developed by OpenAI and the fifth in its series of generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) foundation models.
details: Preceded in the series by GPT-4, it was launched on August 7, 2025. It is publicly accessible to users of the chatbot products ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot as well as to developers through the OpenAI API.

explainer.lead: GPT-5 is OpenAI’s multimodal large language model, launched on August 7, 2025. It is the fifth model in the GPT foundation-model series and is available through ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and the OpenAI API.

tiers.eli5: It's a model that can handle more than text, and you can use it in popular chat apps or build with it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers call GPT-5 through the OpenAI API while consumers reach the same model family via ChatGPT and Copilot. A pitfall: availability through consumer products and the API does not mean identical behavior or settings across those surfaces.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a multimodal Generative Pre-trained Transformer foundation model, fifth in the GPT series after GPT-4; the given facts specify no parameter count or benchmark results.

usedIn.name: ChatGPT
usedIn.detail: Provides public access to GPT-5 through OpenAI’s chatbot product.

usedIn.name: Microsoft Copilot
usedIn.detail: Makes GPT-5 available to users of Microsoft’s chatbot product.

usedIn.name: OpenAI API
usedIn.detail: Allows developers to use GPT-5 in their own applications.

components.name: Multimodal input
components.detail: Accepts more than one kind of information, although the specific supported modalities are not listed.

components.name: GPT-5 model
components.detail: The large language model that processes the input and produces a response.

components.name: Access interfaces
components.detail: ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot serve users, while the OpenAI API serves developers.

flow: A user or developer submits input through ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or the OpenAI API.
GPT-5 processes the multimodal input as a large language model.
The selected product or API returns the model’s response.
explainer.origin: OpenAI developed GPT-5 and launched it on August 7, 2025.
explainer.lineage: GPT-5 is the fifth foundation model in the GPT series and follows GPT-4.
explainer.whyItMatters: GPT-5 extends the GPT series with a multimodal model available to both chatbot users and application developers. Its launch also makes it the successor to GPT-4 in that series.
